$comment: The CI BUILD + LIVENESS MATRIX for the sandbox image (7.9.7c / MOTIR-885).
One entry per agent profile: which AGENT build-arg to build, and the command
that proves the agent is actually RUNNABLE in the finished image — as the
unprivileged `node` user, which is what catches an installer that dropped its
binary somewhere only root can see.
`liveness` is NOT the profile id and NOT agentProfiles.ts's `binary` lookup
key: `antigravity` installs `agy` and `cursor` installs `agent`. It is the
command install-agent.sh's own arm smoke-tests, and packages/cli/test/
sandboxCi.test.ts asserts the two stay identical — a renamed binary in one
place fails the unit lane rather than the 20-minute docker matrix.
`tier` mirrors AGENT_PROFILES (also drift-guarded). Tier 2 is allow-fail in
CI: those installs pull from vendor endpoints Motir does not control, and a
network flake there must not turn a red X on somebody's unrelated pull
request — the honest posture is 'built, reported, not gating'.
